sourceBindings.role: integrated corrected transcription and page-locator record

sourceObservations.use: The approximate source onset near Re 2 is retained only as a diagnostic strict bound; it does not open eligibility without byte-bound operands and protocol fields.
The no-effect observation at Re 7.5 prevents classifying an above-bound row as ventilated.
Any future interval-wide Reynolds record must use the source a-axis definition.
A future absolute record must byte-bind the vertical cloud-tunnel updraft/free-fall transport.
A future absolute record must preserve isolated single-crystal selection and polycrystal exclusion.
A future absolute record must represent the adiabatic-cooling seed protocol and its unreported individual seed details rather than inventing them.
A future absolute interval must lie within the source 180-1800 s range and retain its exact temperature-specific duration.
A future absolute record must represent the reported temperature uncertainty and its time-dependent history.
A future absolute record must preserve nominal liquid-water saturation without converting it to a numeric solver forcing.
A future absolute record must preserve the approximate 1010 mb categorical source regime without an invented tolerance.
A future absolute record must represent the about-8-um droplet population, 5-15-um majority range, and about-0.1-g-per-m3 liquid-water content.
A future absolute record must be unsupported during growth; post-collection oil holding is not a growth substrate.
A future absolute record must preserve the habit-specific measurement method and source a-axis semantics.
A future absolute record must bind the thermistor/hot-wire/strip-chart method and plus-or-minus 0.03 m/s fall-speed accuracy.
A future absolute record must preserve different-crystal-per-duration ensemble semantics.
A future absolute interval must remain inside the temperature-specific riming-free duration.
